acquisition method: The variable window data in-dependent acquisition (DIA) method is described by Bruderer et al. ... The data dependent acquisition (DDA) method was the manufacturer’s default for ‘high sample amount’.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested by incubation with trypsin (1/100, w/w, Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin, Porcine; Promega) for at least 9 h at 37 °C.
collision energy: with a stepped normalized collision energy (NCE) of 25.5, 27 and 30
fractionation method: then fractionated with High pH Reversed-Phase (Pierce) into a total of 96 samples.
instrument: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1 µg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: the resource presented here provides the largest compendium of label-free DIA-SWATH maps for an animal model of infection.
reduction reagent: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
reduction concentration: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
